name: Spanish Common Words Set 25
description: This set contains a collection of common and frequently used Spanish words, part of a larger series designed for language learners.

cards.sentence: La escaladora subió por la roca.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The climber went up the rock.

cards.sentence: Su creencia en sí mismo es muy fuerte.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His belief in himself is very strong.

cards.sentence: El caballero se enfrentó a su viejo enemigo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The knight faced his old enemy.

cards.sentence: Es un trabajador muy dedicado y eficiente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He is a very dedicated and efficient worker.

cards.sentence: Cada invitado recibió un pequeño regalo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Each guest received a small gift.

cards.sentence: El gerente aprobó la nueva propuesta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The manager approved the new proposal.

cards.sentence: El gobernador anunció nuevas políticas de seguridad.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The governor announced new security policies.

cards.sentence: El diputado votó a favor de la ley.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The deputy voted in favor of the law.

cards.sentence: El alcalde inauguró el nuevo parque de la ciudad.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The mayor inaugurated the city's new park.

cards.sentence: Fue el único testigo del accidente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He was the only witness to the accident.

cards.sentence: La policía capturó al criminal después de una larga persecución.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The police captured the criminal after a long chase.

cards.sentence: Siento mucha pena por lo que pasó.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I feel great sorrow for what happened.

cards.sentence: Pasó diez años en prisión.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He spent ten years in prison.

cards.sentence: La celda era pequeña y oscura.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The cell was small and dark.

cards.sentence: La inundación fue un desastre natural.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The flood was a natural disaster.

cards.sentence: En caso de emergencia, llame a este número.
cards.sentenceTranslation: In case of emergency, call this number.

cards.sentence: Necesito tu ayuda para mover esta caja.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need your help to move this box.

cards.sentence: Aceptar el reto es el primer paso.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Accepting the challenge is the first step.

cards.sentence: Es una norma de la escuela no correr en los pasillos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It is a school rule not to run in the hallways.

cards.sentence: Su comportamiento carece de ética profesional.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His behavior lacks professional ethics.

cards.sentence: Cada persona tiene derecho a su propia religión.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Everyone has the right to their own religion.

cards.sentence: Visitamos una antigua sinagoga en el centro de la ciudad.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We visited an ancient synagogue in the city center.

cards.sentence: Muchas culturas creen en un dios creador.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Many cultures believe in a creator god.

cards.sentence: Se dice que cada persona tiene un ángel guardián.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It is said that everyone has a guardian angel.

cards.sentence: En la mitología, el demonio representa el mal.
cards.sentenceTranslation: In mythology, the demon represents evil.

cards.sentence: Las llamas del infierno son un concepto religioso.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The flames of hell are a religious concept.

cards.sentence: Expresó su profunda gratitud por la ayuda recibida.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He expressed his deep gratitude for the help received.

cards.sentence: Pedir perdón es un acto de humildad.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Asking for forgiveness is an act of humility.

cards.sentence: Recordó su infancia con mucha nostalgia.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He remembered his childhood with great nostalgia.

cards.sentence: La vejez trae consigo sabiduría y experiencia.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Old age brings wisdom and experience.

cards.sentence: Después de años, decidieron tramitar el divorcio.
cards.sentenceTranslation: After years, they decided to process the divorce.

cards.sentence: La boda se celebrará en la iglesia local.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The wedding will be celebrated in the local church.

cards.sentence: Recibió una felicitación por su ascenso.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He received a congratulation for his promotion.

cards.sentence: Puso las flores frescas en el florero.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She put the fresh flowers in the vase.

cards.sentence: La igualdad de género es un objetivo importante.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Gender equality is an important goal.

cards.sentence: Tiene conciencia de la importancia de su trabajo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He is aware of the importance of his work.

cards.sentence: Su inteligencia le permite resolver problemas complejos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His intelligence allows him to solve complex problems.

cards.sentence: La creatividad es esencial en el diseño gráfico.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Creativity is essential in graphic design.

cards.sentence: La densidad del agua es de un gramo por centímetro cúbico.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The density of water is one gram per cubic centimeter.

cards.sentence: Tomó una buena posición para ver el espectáculo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He took a good position to see the show.

cards.sentence: La tienda está en la esquina de la calle.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The store is on the corner of the street.

cards.sentence: Sentémonos en el borde de la piscina.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Let's sit on the edge of the pool.

cards.sentence: El exterior de la casa necesita una nueva capa de pintura.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The exterior of the house needs a new coat of paint.

cards.sentence: Llevaba una hermosa joya alrededor de su cuello.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She wore a beautiful jewel around her neck.

cards.sentence: El motor del coche hizo un ruido extraño.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The car's engine made a strange noise.

cards.sentence: Se pinchó una rueda de la bicicleta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: A bicycle wheel got a flat.

cards.sentence: Cayó en el olvido después de muchos años.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It fell into oblivion after many years.

cards.sentence: Presta atención a lo que digo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Pay attention to what I'm saying.

cards.sentence: Necesita mucha concentración para este examen.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He needs a lot of concentration for this exam.

cards.sentence: El aburrimiento puede llevar a la creatividad.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Boredom can lead to creativity.

cards.sentence: La fiesta fue pura diversión para todos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The party was pure fun for everyone.

cards.sentence: Tiene un gran sentido del humor.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He has a great sense of humor.

cards.sentence: Su explicación fue muy clara y concisa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His explanation was very clear and concise.

cards.sentence: La descripción del paisaje era muy vívida.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The description of the landscape was very vivid.

cards.sentence: El informe detalla los resultados de la investigación.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The report details the results of the investigation.

cards.sentence: El héroe salvó a la ciudad del peligro.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The hero saved the city from danger.

cards.sentence: El villano fue derrotado al final de la historia.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The villain was defeated at the end of the story.

cards.sentence: Los niños creen en la magia de la Navidad.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Children believe in the magic of Christmas.

cards.sentence: Por favor, tira el papel en la papelera.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Please throw the paper in the trash can.

cards.sentence: Necesito mi pasaporte para viajar al extranjero.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need my passport to travel abroad.

cards.sentence: Prefiero pagar en efectivo que con tarjeta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I prefer to pay in cash rather than with a card.

cards.sentence: La cajera abrió la caja registradora.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The cashier opened the cash register.

cards.sentence: Vamos al supermercado a comprar víveres.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We're going to the supermarket to buy groceries.

cards.sentence: Compré pan fresco en la panadería de la esquina.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I bought fresh bread at the corner bakery.

cards.sentence: La mejor carne se encuentra en esa carnicería.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The best meat is found at that butcher shop.

cards.sentence: Compramos pescado fresco en la pescadería.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We bought fresh fish at the fish market.

cards.sentence: La farmacia está abierta las 24 horas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The pharmacy is open 24 hours.

cards.sentence: Pasamos horas en la librería buscando libros.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We spent hours at the bookstore looking for books.

cards.sentence: La juguetería tiene los juguetes más nuevos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The toy store has the newest toys.

cards.sentence: Necesito comprar un nuevo par de zapatos en la zapatería.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need to buy a new pair of shoes at the shoe store.

cards.sentence: Fui a la peluquería para cortarme el pelo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I went to the hair salon to get my hair cut.

cards.sentence: Llevé mi traje a la tintorería para que lo limpiaran.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I took my suit to the dry cleaner's to have it cleaned.

cards.sentence: El barco atracó en el muelle del puerto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The ship docked at the pier of the port.

cards.sentence: El faro guía a los barcos por la noche.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The lighthouse guides ships at night.

cards.sentence: Tomamos la autopista para llegar más rápido.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We took the highway to get there faster.

cards.sentence: El semáforo cambió a verde, podemos avanzar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The traffic light turned green, we can go.

cards.sentence: Caminamos por la acera para evitar los coches.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We walked on the sidewalk to avoid the cars.

cards.sentence: Tiene un conocimiento técnico muy profundo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He has a very deep technical knowledge.

cards.sentence: El concierto fue una experiencia musical inolvidable.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The concert was an unforgettable musical experience.

cards.sentence: Es un escritor con un estilo literario único.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He is a writer with a unique literary style.

cards.sentence: Participó en varios eventos deportivos durante el verano.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He participated in several sports events during the summer.

cards.sentence: Este plato es completamente vegetal, sin carne.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This dish is completely vegetable, with no meat.

cards.sentence: El agua mineral es buena para la salud.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Mineral water is good for your health.

cards.sentence: El hielo es agua en estado sólido.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Ice is water in a solid state.

cards.sentence: Necesito un poco de líquido para beber.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need some liquid to drink.

cards.sentence: El aire es una mezcla de gases, por lo tanto, es gaseoso.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Air is a mixture of gases, therefore it is gaseous.

cards.sentence: El cristal es opaco y no permite ver a través.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The glass is opaque and doesn't allow one to see through.

cards.sentence: Está en un nivel avanzado de español.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He is at an advanced level of Spanish.

cards.sentence: Necesito un informe más detallado de la situación.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need a more detailed report of the situation.

cards.sentence: Solo hago visitas ocasionales a la ciudad.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I only make occasional visits to the city.

cards.sentence: Es un trabajo temporal, solo por unos meses.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It's a temporary job, just for a few months.

cards.sentence: Ella busca un empleo permanente, no temporal.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She is looking for a permanent job, not a temporary one.

cards.sentence: El problema tiene soluciones múltiples.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The problem has multiple solutions.

cards.sentence: Los niños estaban muy excitados con la noticia.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The children were very excited about the news.

cards.sentence: El teléfono está completamente cargado.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The phone is fully charged.

cards.sentence: Dibujó una línea diagonal en el papel.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He drew a diagonal line on the paper.

cards.sentence: Sentía una sed ardiente después de correr.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He felt a burning thirst after running.

cards.sentence: Necesito planchar mi camisa para la reunión.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need to iron my shirt for the meeting.

cards.sentence: Es importante consumir alimentos saludables.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It's important to consume healthy foods.

cards.sentence: Nos encontramos en la cafetería para tomar un café.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We met at the coffee shop for a coffee.
